'''Bendii''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Bendii appeared as a [[Color/Legends|blue]] orb. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|six months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] fled [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] pursuit above Bendii while ferrying supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="CSS">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Chewbacca and the Slavers of the Shadowlands]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The first mention of the [[Bendii system/Legends|Bendii star system]] was in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square K-19.<ref name="EAOC" /> The first appearance of Bendii itself was in the [[Star Wars Adventures: Chewbacca and the Slavers of the Shadowlands|sixth issue]] of the [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] graphic-novella series.<ref name="CSS" />
